summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only test (Expo web, 375x667) of Earnings Insights, Notification Capture Tool and Spoken Ride Alerts, plus regression checks. Everything requested works and no page/console errors were seen. Earnings: the totals matched the confirmed rides exactly (₹184+₹310+₹95 = ₹589; weighted ₹/km 589/19.4 = ₹30.36; Rapido ₹279 at ₹22.87/km; Ola ₹310 at ₹43.06/km). A FAILED/NOT_CONFIRMED ₹184 ride was left out. The empty state, the include-simulated toggle (shows ₹0 plus the empty state), the 7-day chart, the per-platform rows and the simulated note all work. Done goes back, and goes to / after a direct load. Capture: the toggle persists. Simulation produced 12 live samples (10 ride, 2 non-ride). The OTP sample shows 'OTP ••••'; 482113 appears neither on screen nor in storage, and the phone number was redacted. Manual parse, labels, agreement % (0% -> 50%), mismatch flag, delete, export to clipboard (redacted JSON, toast), clear+confirm and persistence after reload all work. Voice: the toggle persists after reload, the test announcement plays without a crash, and voice on with simulation running gave no errors. Regression: History export toast, dismiss (state Rejected), dashboard metrics and earnings card all work. Delete local data resets voice and capture to false and samples to []. No deprecated Expo packages found.

issues: Label chips (capture-label-ride/notride-*) and platform chips are 36px tall, and the Delete button (capture-delete-*) is 48x36. All are under the 44pt touch target.
Toast overlays the sample list near the bottom for a few seconds (cosmetic).
Bar value labels are 9px, which is too small to read on a phone.
The 'Include simulated rides' toggle is not persisted and resets to ON on every visit (may be intentional).

action_items: Optional: raise Chip and capture Delete button heights to 44px or more.
Optional: raise the earnings bar value font size (9px -> 11px or more).

Note: the Uber parser keywords (trip request / new trip / driver app) do not match 'New ride request ...' text. The pasted review example is 'Not recognised' when Uber is selected but parses correctly for Rapido and Ola. This may be intended; consider adding a 'ride request' keyword for Uber if real samples use that wording.
Code hygiene: rideStore.ts is 727 lines (over 700) and should be split (e.g. capture/samples and voice slices).
critical_code_review_comments: earnings.ts: correct filter (ACCEPTED + evidence CONFIRMED + fare > 0); weighted ₹/km leaves out rides with no trip distance; days are DST-safe.
earnings.tsx computes the summary with useMemo over Date.now(), so if the screen stays open past midnight 'Today' does not roll over until the rides change (minor).
earnings-close and capture-close are Text with onPress (no accessibilityRole='button'); the hit area is 46x44, which is OK.
voiceAlerts.ts: try/catch only catches synchronous throws; expo-speech async onError is not handled (minor).
seed_data_creation: None; data came from Simulation Mode and pasted samples in isolated browser contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh browser context, so localStorage does not carry over between calls; do the whole flow in one script. Use tab text (get_by_text('Requests', exact=True).last) to navigate. page.goto reloads the page and can lose the 150ms debounced persist. The simulator emits every 8s and needs about 80s to cycle all scenarios; simulated accept confirms about 85% of the time. Storage keys: rideassist_*_v1 (rides is a double-JSON-encoded string).
